_note: STRUCTURAL / CORPORATE-ACTION calendar — the dated events catalyst_calendar was blind to. Trigger (2026-07-22 audit): the desk logged its own failure twice — 'catalyst_calendar 모듈이 2런 연속 KR 최대 바이너리를 놓침', patched by hand both times. These are the CHEAPEST class of catalyst to stop missing because the dates are knowable in advance. Same discipline as econ_schedule.json: every row carries source + confidence so VERIFIED is never confused with ESTIMATE (P4). confidence: 'confirmed'=pulled from the official source this session · 'pattern'=rule-derived (e.g. MSCI reviews are quarterly) · 'estimate'=needs verification. Index-rebalance rows are DERIVED by the script from `rebalance_rules` — do not hand-enter them here.

_schema.date: YYYY-MM-DD (the day the market can act on it)
_schema.event: one line, in the market's own words
_schema.ticker: affected name, or null for market-wide
_schema.axis: lockup | offering | rebalance | short_designation | conversion | governance
_schema.binary: true if it resolves one way or the other on that date
_schema.note: why it moves price — mechanism, not narrative
